meta.title: Careers
meta.desc: Safe House Insurance is always hiring in El Paso. Send us your resume — personal lines, commercial lines and customer service.

hero.lede:
No postings, no closing dates. We are a growing agency in El Paso and we would rather meet
     the right person than wait for a vacancy to open. Send us your resume and we will read it.

work.p1:
Safe House is an independent agency, which means we shop a shelf of carriers on behalf of the
     person in front of us rather than selling one company's product. Day to day that looks like
     quoting, explaining, and then looking after the policy afterwards — payments, changes,
     ID cards, claims, the renewal a year later.
work.p2:
The customers are our neighbors: families in El Paso and Las Cruces, work trucks, first-time
     drivers, people with a foreign license who have been told no somewhere else. A lot of the job
     is patience and plain language.

kinds.h2: The kind of work we take people on for
kinds.lead:
Not a list of openings — a description of what happens here. Tell us which
       of these sounds like you, or tell us something we have not thought of.

c1.p:
Car, home, renters, motorcycle. Quoting, advising and servicing the policies that make up
         most of what we write.

c2.p:
Work trucks, fleets, tow rigs and small business. More moving parts, longer conversations,
         and a customer whose livelihood is on the policy.

c3.p:
The person who answers when something has gone wrong or a payment did not go through. Not
         a stepping stone — it is the job most people judge us by.

c1.p:
Genuinely both. Half of our conversations start in Spanish and a customer can tell
         immediately whether you are comfortable or translating.

c2.p:
A Texas General Lines license is ideal. If you do not have one and you are serious about
         getting it, say so; we would rather train someone good than hire someone available.

c3.p:
Telling a customer the honest number, including when it is higher than they hoped or when
         we are not the right agency for them. That is the whole reputation.

c4.p:
Insurance is follow-through: the document that still needs a signature, the payment due
         Friday, the call back you promised. The work is mostly remembering.
